<style>
  #login-tab-container {
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin-inline: var(--desktop-content--x-padding);

    @media (min-width: 1680px) {
      margin-inline: auto;
      max-width: 1432px;
    }
  }
</style>

<style>
  .break-word {
    margin-top: 82px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    font-size: 48px !important;
    font-weight: 300 !important;
  }

  .sj-course-info-wrapper h2 {
    margin-top: 0px;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 300 !important;
    color: #63707b;
  }
</style>

<style>
  i {
    font-family: skilljar !important
  }

  i.fa {
    font-family: FontAwesome !important
  }

  .sj-page-lesson #lp-wrapper #lesson-main-content sjwc-lesson-content-item {
    background-color: #eee
  }

  .sj-page-lesson #lp-wrapper #lesson-main-content sjwc-lesson-content-item .sjwc-section-title {
    background-color: #eee
  }

  @media only screen and (min-width: 768px) {
    #skilljar-content {
      padding-top: 50px;
    }
  }

  #skilljar-content {
    background-color: #ffffff;

    .top-row.sj-courseboxes-v2 {
      padding-top: 0;
    }

    .catalog-center-width.one-col-full {
      margin-block: 50px;
    }

    .catalog-header span {
      font-size: 20px !important;
      line-height: 150% !important;
      font-weight: 300 !important;
    }
  }

  #catalog-courses {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container {
    padding: 8px 8px 56px;
    width: 350px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 3px;
    margin: 0 12px 40px;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container:hover {
    box-shadow: none;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container:before,
  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container:after {
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container .coursebox-text {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 26px;
    line-height: 40px;
    color: #0d0e10;
    padding: 0px;
    margin: 20px 0;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container .coursebox-callout {
    font-weight: 400;
    border-top: solid 1px #d5dce0;
    padding-top: 14px;
    margin: 0px 15px 9px 15px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.67;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-align: left;
    color: #848f99;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    left: 1em;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .coursebox-image {
    display: flex;
    height: 222px;
    margin: 0;
    width: 100%;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course img {
    border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
    margin: auto;
    max-height: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .tag-callout-container {
    padding-top: 10px !important;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .tag-callout-container .auto-tag-callout {
    color: rgba(13, 14, 16, 0.5);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .coursebox-text-description {
    font-weight: 400;
    display: block;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 32px;
    color: #0d0e10;
    padding: 0px;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    min-height: 110px;
  }

  @media only screen and (max-width: 626px) {
    #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .coursebox-text-description {
      font-size: 13px !important;
    }
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .storefront-price {
    display: none;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .coursebox-callout {
    border-top: solid 1px #9ca6af;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 16px;
    text-transform: capitalize;
    text-align: left;
    padding-top: 14px;
    margin: 0px 15px 9px 15px;
    left: 1em;
    margin-right: 150px;
    margin-left: -7px;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .coursebox-callout>span {
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 16px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: #848f99;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .course-time span {
    text-transform: lowercase;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .path-item-count {
    text-transform: lowercase;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container.course .catalog-page-callout span {
    text-transform: none;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container:before {
    content: "";
    top: 8px;
    left: 8px;
    right: 8px;
    bottom: -15px;
    background: white;
    position: absolute;
    border: none;
    z-index: -2;
    display: block;
    border-radius: 3px;
  }

  #skilljar-content .coursebox-container:after {
    content: "";
    border-radius: 3px;
    position: absolute;
    top: 5px;
    left: 5px;
    bottom: -8px;
    right: 5px;
    background: white;
    border: none;
    z-index: -2;
  }
</style>

<style>
  body #onetrust-consent-sdk #onetrust-banner-sdk a[href] {
    color: white;
    margin-left: 0px;
    mix-blend-mode: difference;
  }
</style>

<style>
  header#header #header-right .language-pack-wrapper {
    position: relative;

    & .ps-list.header-nested-links {
      right: 0;
    }

    & .styled-link {
      display: none;
    }
  }
</style>

<style>
  .catalog-center-width .catalog-header .ch-contents .ch-text-container .ch-link {
    padding: 16px 32px;
    background-color: #0d0d0d;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 30px;
    border: 1px solid #6e6e6e;
    border-radius: 100px;

    &:hover {
      background-color: #3d3d3d;
    }
  }
</style>

<style>
  header#header .header-wrapper {
    padding: 0 calc((100vw - 1432px) / 2);

    @media only screen and (max-width: 1500px) {
      padding: 0 calc((100vw - 1148px) / 2);
    }

    @media only screen and (max-width: 1213px) {
      padding: 0 calc((100vw - 860px) / 2);
    }

    @media only screen and (max-width: 926px) {
      padding: 0 calc((100vw - 768px) / 2);
    }

    @media only screen and (max-width: 801px) {
      padding: 0 calc((100vw - 584px) / 2);
    }

    @media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
      padding: 0 calc((100vw - 606px) / 2);

      #header-right {
        padding-inline-end: 24px;
      }
    }

    @media only screen and (max-width: 607px) {
      padding: 0 calc((100vw - 546px) / 2);
    }
  }
</style>

<style>
  #skilljar-content .top-row.sj-courseboxes-v2 .swimlane-section {
    & .ts-wrapper {

      &:nth-child(1),
      &:nth-child(4) {
        background-color: #1e1f21;
      }

      & .section__content {
        margin: auto;
        padding-inline: 24px;

        .course-control.control-prev i {
          margin-left: 0;
          left: -66px;
        }

        .course-control.control-next i {
          left: unset;
          right: -36px;
        }

        @media only screen and (min-width: 545px) {
          width: 528px;
        }

        @media only screen and (min-width: 607px) {
          width: 590px;
        }

        @media only screen and (max-width: 544px) {
          width: 100%;
        }

        @media only screen and (min-width: 801px) {
          width: 784px;
        }

        @media only screen and (min-width: 926px) {
          width: 909px;
        }

        @media only screen and (min-width: 1213px) {
          width: 1196px;
        }

        @media only screen and (min-width: 1500px) {
          width: 1483px;
        }
      }
    }
  }
</style>

<style>
  #global-header {
    padding: 0;
    margin-inline: auto;
    border-block-end: 1px solid #e5e5e5;

    & button {
      margin-block-end: 0;

      &:hover,
      &:active,
      &:focus {
        background-color: transparent;
      }

      &:focus {
        background-color: transparent;
        color: unset;
      }
    }
  }

  #header {
    position: sticky;
    height: fit-content;

    &.header--fixed {
      position: fixed;
    }

    & .header-wrapper #header-left {
      padding-block: 24px;
      padding-inline: 0;

      & a.header-logo-link.focus-link-v2 {
        display: flex;
        gap: 16px;
        align-items: center;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
        line-height: 2rem;
        color: #000000;
        text-wrap: nowrap;

        & .local-header__logo-wrapper {
          display: flex;
          height: 28px;
          width: 0;
          transition: all 0.3s;
          margin-inline-end: 0;
          overflow: hidden;

          &.show {
            margin-inline-end: 16px;
            width: 30px;
          }

          & .local-header__logo {
            min-width: 30px;
            min-height: 28px;
            padding: unset;
          }
        }

        & img {
          &.header-logo-svg {
            display: none;
          }
        }
      }

      & .header-link-container {
        & .header-link {
          font-size: 1rem;
          line-height: 1.25rem;
          font-weight: 400;
        }
      }
    }

    & .header-wrapper #header-right {
      padding-block: 24px;

      & .language-pack-wrapper {
        display: none;
      }

      & .search-container #catalog-search-box {
        margin: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: row-reverse;
        border: 1px solid grey;
        border-radius: 50px;

        & input {
          border: none;
          border-radius: unset;
          background: transparent;
          box-shadow: none;
          font-size: 1rem;
          line-height: 1.25rem;
          padding-block: 12px;
          padding-inline-start: 0;
          color: #000000;
        }

        & .catalog-search-input-button-wrapper {
          width: unset;
          background: transparent;
          border: none;

          & button {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            box-shadow: none;
          }
        }
      }

      & .header-link.login-link span.small.button {
        font-size: 1rem;
        line-height: 1.25rem;
        font-weight: 400;
        background-color: transparent;
        color: #000000;
      }
    }
  }
</style>

<style>
  #lesson-main-inner {
    & .lesson-top {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 32px;
      margin-block-end: 20px;

      & .live-training-title-container {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 48px;

        & h1 {
          font-size: 30px;
          margin: 0;
        }

        & h2 {
          margin: 0;
          font-size: 20px !important;
        }
      }

      &>h2 {
        display: none !important;
      }
    }

    & #lesson-main-content {
      & .course-text-content.course-scrollable-content {
        border: none;
        font-size: 16px;
        padding: 0;

        .completed-quiz {
          h1 {
            span {
              font-size: 30px;
            }
          }

          p,
          span,
          div {
            font-size: 20px;
          }

          button {
            background-color: #FF584A;
          }

          a {
            color: #FF584A;

            span {
              font-size: 30px;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
</style>

<style>
  #main-container {
    position: relative;
    overflow-x: clip !important;

    & #catalog-left-nav,
    #lp-left-nav {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      transition: top 0s;
    }

    &.fixed {
      padding-block-start: 68px !important;

      @media (max-width: 1120px) {
        padding-block-start: 56px !important;
      }

      & #catalog-left-nav,
      #lp-left-nav {
        position: fixed;
        top: 68px;

        @media (max-width: 1120px) {
          top: 56px;
        }
      }
    }

    & #skilljar-content,
    & #lp-wrapper {
      padding-block: 0 !important;
    }
  }

  section.local-nav {
    /* Start of CSS resets */

    /* Input reset */
    input {
      margin: 0;
      box-shadow: none;

      &:focus::placeholder {
        color: transparent !important;
      }
    }

    /* Heading Reset */
    h1,
    h2,
    h3,
    h4,
    h5,
    h6 {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      font-size: inherit;
      font-weight: normal;
      line-height: inherit;
    }

    /* Paragraph Reset */
    p {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      line-height: inherit;
    }

    /* Button Reset */
    button {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: inherit;
      line-height: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: inherit;
    }

    /* List Reset */
    ul,
    ol {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Link Reset */
    a {
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    /* End of CSS resets */

    /* Start of common styles */
    .hide-element {
      display: none !important;
    }

    .show-element {
      display: unset !important;
    }

    & .arrow {
      transform: rotate(180deg);
      margin-top: -8px;
    }

    & .arrow::after {
      content: "\2303";
      font-size: 16px;
      color: #0d0d0d;
    }

    /* End of common styles */

    height: 56px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    padding-inline: 24px;
    gap: 16px;
    border-block: 1px solid #e7e7e7;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 100;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;

    &.local-nav--fixed {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
    }

    & .dropdown__navigation-item a,
    .login__container>a,
    .user__container>a {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      height: 100%;
      position: relative;
      color: #727272;

      &:after {
        content: " ";
        width: 100%;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        border-bottom: 3px solid var(--glow-coral);
        opacity: 0;
        transition: opacity var(--transition-duration-long);
      }

      &:hover:after {
        opacity: 1;
      }

      &:hover {
        color: #0d0e10;
      }
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      padding-inline: 48px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1120px) {
      /* height: 68px; */
      padding-inline: 64px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1441px) {
      padding-inline: 76px;
    }

    @media (min-width: 1680px) {
      padding-inline: 124px;
    }

    & .local-nav__left {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;

      @media (min-width: 1120px) {
        gap: 32px;
      }

      &.search--active {
        display: none;

        @media (min-width: 768px) {
          display: flex;
        }
      }

      & .brand-container {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;

        & .logo__container {
          display: flex;
          height: 28px;
          width: 0;
          transition: all 0.3s;
          margin-inline-end: 0;
          overflow: hidden;

          &.show {
            width: 30px;
          }

          & .logo {
            width: 19px;
            height: auto;
          }
        }

        & .brand-name {
          font-size: 1.25rem;
          line-height: 150%;
          font-weight: 400;
          letter-spacing: 0;
          color: #0d0d0d;
          text-wrap: nowrap;
        }
      }

      & .dropdown__trigger {
        height: 100%;
        width: 48px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;

        @media (min-width: 1120px) {
          display: none;
        }
      }

      & .dropdown__container {
        display: none;
        position: absolute;
        top: 57px;
        right: 0;
        width: 100%;
        flex-direction: column;
        z-index: 1000;
        background-color: #ffffff;

        &.dropdown--active {
          display: flex;
        }

        & .dropdown__navigation-items {
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          height: 100%;
          gap: 24px;

          & .dropdown__navigation-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
            padding: 16px 24px;
            font-size: 0.875rem;
            line-height: 1.3125rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: #727272;

            @media (min-width: 768px) {
              padding-inline: 48px;
            }

            @media (min-width: 1120px) {
              &:last-child {
                display: none;
              }
            }
          }
        }

        & .login__container {
          padding: 16px 24px;

          @media (min-width: 768px) {
            padding-inline: 48px;
          }

          & .login__button,
          & .logout__button {
            height: 45px;
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border: 1px solid #6e6e6e;
            border-radius: 25px;

            & span {
              font-size: 0.875rem;
              line-height: 1.3125rem;
              font-weight: 500;
              color: #0d0d0d;
            }
          }
        }

        @media (min-width: 1120px) {
          position: unset;
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: row;
          align-items: center;

          & .dropdown__navigation-items {
            flex-direction: row;
          }

          & .dropdown__navigation-item {
            padding: 0 !important;

            & a {
              /* padding-inline: 12px; */
            }
          }

          & .login__container {
            display: none;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    & .local-nav__right {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;

      & .search__container {
        flex: 1;
        height: 36px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        border-radius: 30px !important;

        & span {
          display: flex;
        }

        & .search__toggle,
        & .search__cancel {
          height: 100%;
          width: 100%;
          max-width: 48px;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          color: #0d0d0d;
        }

        & .search__input {
          display: none;
          height: 32px;
          width: 100%;
          padding: 0;
          border: none;
          border-radius: 28px;
          font-size: 0.875rem;
          line-height: 1.5;
          color: #0d0d0d;
          transition: 0.3s ease;

          &::placeholder {
            font-size: 0.875rem;
            font-weight: 300;
            color: #0d0d0d;
          }

          &:focus {
            outline: none;
            background-color: transparent;
            box-shadow: none;
          }
        }

        & .search__cancel {
          display: none;
          color: #6e6e6e;
        }

        &.search--active {
          border: 1px solid #e7e7e7;
          border-radius: 20px;

          & .search__input {
            display: block;
          }

          & .search__cancel {
            display: flex;
          }
        }
      }

      & .session__container {
        height: 100%;
      }

      & .login__container {
        height: 100%;

        & .login__button {
          width: 100%;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;

          & span {
            font-size: 0.875rem;
            line-height: 1.3125rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: inherit;
          }
        }
      }

      & .user__container {
        height: 100%;
        display: none;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 24px;
        position: relative;

        & .user__courses-link {
          font-size: 0.875rem;
          font-weight: 500;
          line-height: 1.3125rem;
          color: #727272;
          text-wrap: nowrap;
        }

        & .user-avatar__container {
          display: flex;
          gap: 4px;
          align-items: center;
        }

        & .user-avatar {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          width: 32px;
          height: 32px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          background-color: #ffdcff;

          & .user-avatar__initials {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.125rem;
            color: #6a0085;
          }
        }

        & .user__dropdown {
          display: none;
          position: absolute;
          top: 56px;
          right: 0;
          width: 280px;
          flex-direction: column;
          border-radius: 4px;
          padding-block: 8px;
          z-index: 1000;
          background-color: #fff;
          box-shadow: 5px 5px 20px 0px #6d6e6f93;

          &.user__dropdown--active {
            display: flex;
          }

          & .user__data {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 10px 20px;

            & .user-avatar {
              width: 45px;
              height: 45px;
              flex-shrink: 0;
            }

            & .user__info {
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
              overflow: hidden;

              & span {
                overflow: hidden;
                text-overflow: ellipsis;
                white-space: nowrap;
              }

              & .user__name {
                font-size: 0.875rem;
                font-weight: 500;
                line-height: 1.5rem;
                color: #0d0d0d;
              }

              & .user__email {
                font-size: 0.875rem;
                font-weight: 400;
                line-height: 1.3125rem;
                color: #727272;
              }
            }
          }

          & hr {
            width: 100%;
            border: none;
            border-top: 1px solid #2f2d2b1a;
            margin: 8px 0;
          }

          & .logout__button {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 10px 20px;

            & span {
              font-size: 0.875rem;
              font-weight: 400;
              line-height: 1.5rem;
              color: #727272;

              &:first-child {
                font-size: 1rem;
                margin-block-start: 6px;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      @media (min-width: 1120px) {
        justify-content: flex-end;
        gap: 24px;

        & .search__container {
          flex: unset;
          max-width: 270px;
          width: 100%;
          border: 1px solid #e7e7e7;

          & .search__toggle {
            pointer-events: none;
